question: Which open debug-proxy CA recovery PR should be the canonical implementation: this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109946?
rationale: Both open branches address the same CA-generation interruption and partial-output root cause, but their publication and locking approaches differ; selecting one is an ownership and implementation-direction choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt this PR after refreshed proof
options.body: Keep this branch as the canonical fix after it is rebased or otherwise refreshed and publishes real OpenSSL timeout/retry proof for its current head.

options.title: Adopt the related PR instead
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109946 if its current implementation and proof better fit the proxy-capture owner boundary, then close the other duplicate branch.

options.title: Consolidate into an owner-authored fix
options.body: Extract the preferred bounded-generation and recovery invariants into one narrowly owned replacement if neither external branch is the desired long-term shape.

recommendation.title: Adopt this PR after refreshed proof
recommendation.body: Keep this branch as the canonical fix after it is rebased or otherwise refreshed and publishes real OpenSSL timeout/retry proof for its current head.
